actions.action: Check ceramic cachepot isn't collecting water underneath
Cut back flower spikes above leaf pairs and trim leggy stems by a third
Pinch growing tips every few weeks
Repot into pot 2-5 cm wider with drainage hole, potting mix and perlite
Water when top 2-3 cm of soil is dry
Move to sunniest window or run grow light 12-14 hours a day
Feed balanced liquid fertilizer at half strength every 2-4 weeks
Harden off outdoors over 7-10 days, gradually increasing time and sun
Plant outside in full sun in well-draining soil 45-60 cm apart once nights stay above 10°C
Bring in or take cuttings before first frost
Root non-flowering 10 cm stem tips in water for propagation

reason: The answer correctly says the plant is healthy and its main advice (cut the flowers, repot, balanced fertilizer) matches the fix that worked; the slightly smaller pot size isn't harmful.
